Train on shares of the rows: does more data help?

Holds the settings of Train > Learning curve: the graph is trained on shares of each fold's training rows and scored on those rows and on the fold. Data passes through unchanged, so Train trains as usual; Results' table is the second output after a run.

| | |
| --- | --- |

| **Results** | Dataset | No | 1 | The last run: one row per training (fold, share, rows, scores) |

## Settings

| Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| folds | `folds` | Integer | `5` |   | The run | Folds, 2 to 20. |
| seed | `seed` | Integer | `42` |   | The run | Seed for the folds and the subsets. |
| train_sizes | `train_sizes` | Text | `10%, 25%, 50%, 75%, 100%` |   | The run | Shares of each fold's training rows. |
| results_table | `results_table` | Text | `learning_curve_results` |   | The run | Name the last run's table is published under. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

## Where it runs

| Where | Runs |
| --- | --- |
| Data pipeline (run the graph, **Run step**, previews) | Yes; the result can be saved as a table |

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.
